subject: Character Limit on New User Invite Message?

messages.author: 7e1f2372c4ccb115
messages.subject: Character Limit on New User Invite Message?
parts:
Does anyone know what the character limit on the new user invite message is?

If the limit is exceeded, a small warning appears and the invite is not sent.  This warning is innocuously in the lower right hand corner, and I've missed it a few times.  Would be nice to just know character limit.
